stages.title: Definitions/assets
stages.observable: Ordered layers, delay/scale/position patches and merged asset references match fixture literals; missing catalog entry differs from missing definition; concurrent load resolves once.
exclusions: Plain JSON/files are the shipping input; H0PK import is excluded until its omitted binary schema is supplied (G01).

stages.title: Normalization
stages.observable: Partial nested merge preserves siblings, seed becomes integer, gradient stops sort, reversed legacy state migrates, out-of-range frame selection clamps and all-zero holds are repaired.
exclusions: Unspecified defaults remain explicit U00 gaps (G12).

stages.title: Curves/RNG
stages.observable: Seed 1 recurrence's first integer is 16807; zero fallback and unsigned conversion checked; asymmetric Hermite tangents distinguish left[3]/right[2]; fixed gradient selects fraction 1; missing scalar/color gives 0/white. Two-emitter stream test fails if each emitter is independently reseeded.

stages.title: Spawn/scheduler
stages.observable: Configured maxima 3/256/300 produce capacities 3/256/256; full capacity consumes no spawn draws only if specified in the accepted contract; delay, duration boundary, fractional rates, repeated bursts and loop reset checked with authored expected schedules. Cover every documented shape code and unsupported-code origin/+Z behavior.
exclusions: Unspecified distribution formulas cannot pass fidelity (G04).

stages.title: Update/state
stages.observable: Age-at-life removes before motion; gravity/force/damping/drag order differs from reversed order; total velocity uses displacement; threshold dt case, world/local transforms, UV wrapping and trail exact-age retention tested.
exclusions: Orbit/noise and UV equations absent from the report are explicit gaps (G05, G06).

stages.title: Effect clock
stages.observable: 1/120 boundary with 1e-9 epsilon, dt cap before tempo, backward seek reset, stop-then-expiry and emitter completion AND-condition pass. Prewarm follows floating repeated 1/60 additions rather than replacing with an integer count; expected step count is independently enumerated.

stages.title: Instances/trails
stages.observable: Mode 0/1/4 buffers, handedness, pivot, depth order, dirty count and maximum 1024 trail segments checked from literal geometry; Windows clone screenshots from cameras 0/45/90 degrees with no clipped/absent required geometry.

stages.title: Materials/shaders
stages.observable: Independently authored textures and quads exercise four material branches, each named keyword, NoColorSpace+sRGB flags, white fallback, analytic floor fade, additive and straight-alpha blend with depthWrite off. Readback patches must meet predeclared analytic expectations within 2 byte levels/channel.
exclusions: Omitted equations block exact shader parity; no golden generated by the same unverified implementation counts as an oracle (G07).

stages.title: Capture
stages.observable: round(seconds*60), ratio 1.7, alpha threshold 30, k bounds 2-8; 256-square bounds pass, black/white/half-black reconstruction, vertical orientation and origin with an authored asymmetric primitive. Preserve shared shader clock across passes. No HunFXPost inserted.

stages.title: Pixel stages
stages.observable: Empty rejection, alpha-weighted half-color reconstruction, threshold equality, ceiling levels, percentile/ramp ordering, custom palette bypass, 8-connected island and 4-connected hole cases, Bayer phases and inner/outer 4/8-neighbor outlines. A 40001+ sample fixture records random sampling separately; never promises seed-only byte equality.
exclusions: Exact grading/distance/dither coefficients are U00 gaps where the report omits them (G08).

stages.title: Timing
stages.observable: [1,0,3] gives two retained/four baked frames; holds clamp 0-8; marker fps change, all-zero fallback, inclusive range before baking and default unrecommended holds checked.
exclusions: Recommendation heuristics beyond reported coverage basis are gap-gated (G13).

stages.title: Alternate captures
stages.observable: Authored asymmetric 2x2 flipbook validates cells/ramp/rotation/flip/fps route; authored ambient layers validate each listed family and half-color contract. Compare phase t and t+L in the clone for loop seam claims, not first and last sampled frame.
exclusions: Ambient generator/formula details absent from the report remain gaps, not invented reference presets (G09).

stages.title: Export encoders
stages.observable: Independently decode PNG, GIF, ZIP and Aseprite; compare dimensions, RGBA, holds/delays, CRC, frame count and selected chunks to hand-authored fixtures. Parse JSON/Godot/Unity; sheet rectangles/origin/ppu correct. Unity IDs excluded from byte-equality comparisons; validate uniqueness/shape.
exclusions: Binary field details are gap-gated, not inferred from labels (G10).

stages.title: Export orchestration/sinks
stages.observable: Clone UI exports selected range to task-owned folder; decoded files reflect dropped/baked holds; effect/view/seed jobs expand, sprite only once; one bad job does not stop following jobs. GIF default remains repeat independently of effect loop; verify encoded extension. Desktop sink denies path escape and reports actual write failures.

stages.title: UI/settings
stages.observable: Native desktop actions import F01, set seed 42, camera 45, palette/alpha/outline, holds [1,0,3], export and reload clone. Persisted values and decoded output agree; stale capture cannot replace newer selection; 13 cache entries evict to 12; pixel/export-only changes do not recapture. Event subscriptions precede actions, no sleep-based tests.
exclusions: U13 owns native-action adapters and their accessible control identifiers; the accepted action log must include exact resolved controls and inputs, not only internal function calls.

stages.title: Harness capability gate (U00-owned prerequisite)
stages.observable: PASS requires WebGL instancing, ImageData, OffscreenCanvas PNG encoding, CompressionStream deflate and crypto.getRandomValues to succeed in the selected Electron runtime.
exclusions: Clone infrastructure, not product behavior or reference observation. U06-U14 add disjoint qa/cases/<case>.mjs files; no worker edits the shared launcher after U00 without coordinator integration.
